source_path: Floom original. Published from the edge-fastlane-video kit (v1.0.0, created 2026-09-28) after a redistribution audit on 2026-10-04.
note: The kit was written with Federico De Ponte in an AI assistant conversation on 2026-09-28 (the assistant is not recorded in the kit) and used by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code to make three Edge skill films on 2026-10-03 (examples/README.md). For publication it was renamed (the old name carried another company's brand), generalised from Edge-only to any brand kit, and stripped of everything third-party: other companies' logos, a third-party creator's posts and skill used as the starter story, a community post, a reference film by another company, and private workspace paths. The starter copy is now placeholders. references/one-stage-film.md and references/brand-kit.md are new, written from the build reports of the example films. No font files, music or footage are bundled.
